entries.rationale: The frozen v1 channel-neutral ingestion envelope remains authoritative.
EvidenceRef remains the immutable pointer to a source span and is not an aggregate record.
ExtractedFact already expresses a proposed, evidence-backed model statement.
The frozen v1 draft-only mutation remains constrained to internal AI Draft records.
The frozen v1 command remains the human-authorized internal execution boundary.
The frozen v1 cursor, replay and connector lease contract remains sufficient.
A governed aggregate is needed around, but does not replace, the EvidenceRef pointer.
Confirmed versioned facts are semantically distinct from ExtractedFact proposals.
Conflicting fact versions must be retained and explicitly resolved.
Decision inputs, operator, basis, outcome and effective time need a traceable record.
A proposal precedes human review and cannot execute an ApprovedCommand.
Approval records the human review outcome; ApprovedCommand remains the separate executable internal command.
Execution lifecycle and outcome are distinct from proposal, approval and command authorization.
Post-execution evidence is required before an action chain can be considered verified.
Durable agent work needs budget, lease, retry, version and causal metadata.
Append-only lifecycle events provide task recovery and audit history.
Official KPI ownership, window, unit, lineage, exclusions and reconciliation need governance.
Official values must carry definition version, freshness, coverage, reconciliation and lineage.
A synthetic, governed read envelope is needed without enabling a generic form, SQL or writer surface.
